description: This file defines an interface 'IDeploymentConfiguration' as part of the Orleans.Streams namespace. The interface provides a method for retrieving all configured silo names in a distributed Orleans deployment.

classes.name: IDeploymentConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for accessing deployment configuration, specifically for retrieving silo instance names.

methods.name: GetAllSiloNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all configured silo names.
